definition: Reverso is a company specialized in AI-based language tools, translation aids, and language services.
details: These include online translation based on neural machine translation (NMT), contextual dictionaries, online bilingual concordances, definition dictionaries, grammar and spell checking and conjugation tools.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. That pattern-earned fluency is Reverso (language tools).
